I finished the RA1b merge and committed it locally as 0b26b9a (condensed into 8251007); I did not push. Every check passes except one parity case, wigner3j_large_j100_30_m99_-30, where the new values are closer to exact than the baseline.

Conflicts

  • properties/waves.rs: I kept both translation scale properties. They now share one check function that takes the scale factor and tolerance. Both now also check how the gradient and wavenumber derivative scale.
  • docs/status.md: I kept both sides' additions. RA1b says spherical field evaluation still returns NaN for outgoing lmax 40 at 1e-7. I reproduced that on the merged code, so the sentence stays.
  • tests/test_wigner.py: I kept the lane's layout and markers and added RA1b's exact Racah tests. I dropped RA1b's copy of the Ewald test, which HEAD had already moved to test_integral_adjoints.py.

Code that needed porting

  • A test in polar.rs used the removed angular::angular. It now uses angular::on_sphere.
  • RA1b's new check_wigner_d in properties/special.rs called rotation::spherical with the old argument types and did not compile. It now passes borrowed bases.
  • In tests/test_invariants.py, git placed RA1b's new test under the next test's category marker. I restored that marker and marked the new test physics.
  • fields.rs, lattice.rs, basis.rs, tmatrix.rs, iterative.rs and the bindings compile unchanged.

Expected failures fixed by RA1b

  • The tiny-displacement translation NaN and the Wigner 3j argument-order accuracy loss both passed unexpectedly. They are now plain tests with the same assertions, and docs/status.md lists four expected failures instead of six.
  • No other expected failure passed.
  • One change you didn't ask for: the translation composition test in tests/test_translation.py had avoided short displacements only because of that NaN. It now reaches 1e-40 and subnormal values, and passed 400 extra examples.

Checks

Check Result
just build-ext, cargo fmt, clippy, cargo doc pass
cargo test -p treams-core 186 passed
ruff, pyrefly, agent docs check pass
full pytest 4335 passed, 36 skipped, 23 expected failures, none passing unexpectedly

Parity battery 127 of 128 cases pass. The failing case wigner3j_large_j100_30_m99_-30 is off from the baseline by 1.50e-10. I checked it with exact rational arithmetic, which agrees with SymPy. Its largest relative error across the row drops from 1.50e-10 to 1.26e-13.

Every other Wigner 3j case that changed also moved closer to the exact values:

scalar_extremes 2.75e-14 closer to exact

To see what this merge alone changed, I also built the pre-merge code and recorded the battery with it:

  • hot_scattered_fields_spherical_near_axes: it moved by 4.67e-12 and still passes. The translation tables differ by at most 1.06e-15 and the cluster coefficients by 1.1e-15. High-degree outgoing waves close to the particles amplify that. Earlier merges had already moved this case by 1.22e-12.
  • The other 29 translation, cluster, periodic and field cases: they changed by at most 7.3e-15.
  • lattice_sums_spherical_generic: its near-miss (2.18e-11) was there before and this merge doesn't change it.

Logs and the exact-value check script are in ra1b-merge/.
